description: This file defines interfaces and functions for filesystem plugins in the cAdvisor project, including plugin registration, selection, and background monitoring.

classes.name: FsPlugin
classes.description: Interface for filesystem-specific statistics collection and handling.

classes.name: FsCachingPlugin
classes.description: Optional interface for plugins that cache stats by a key.

classes.name: FsWatcherPlugin
classes.description: Optional interface for plugins providing background monitoring.

classes.name: FsWatcher
classes.description: Interface for background filesystem usage monitoring.

classes.name: PartitionInfo
classes.description: Contains information needed for filesystem stats collection.

classes.name: FsStats
classes.description: Contains filesystem statistics returned by plugins.

methods.name: RegisterPlugin
methods.description: Registers a filesystem plugin by name.

methods.name: GetPluginForFsType
methods.description: Returns the plugin suitable for a given filesystem type.

methods.name: InitializeWatchers
methods.description: Starts background watchers for all plugins that support it.
